title: London public contracts (Contracts Finder)
what: Procurement notices London buyers published on the UK government's Contracts Finder in the last 24 hours: notice page, stage, title, buyer (mostly public bodies, sometimes an agent publishing for one), value, award value and deadline. No supplier or contact is kept.

schedule.how: data.b@'s wake (twice a day, 07:03 and 18:03 Lisbon) runs it when its last read is more than 5.5 hours old: six 4-hour windows of up to 100 notices each from the published OCDS search, 2.5 s apart

terms.summary: Open Government Licence v3.0, Crown copyright (Crown Commercial Service); credit every value with: "Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0." Every OCDS package carries the licence. robots.txt has no rules (page not found). The published search needs no token. Natural persons are not kept (suppliers can be sole traders). Not reviewed by a person.
terms.quote: All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
terms.republish: yes, OGL v3.0, with the attribution statement
terms.open_question: Answered by rights@PrompTugal.dinis, finding R13 (19 Nov 2026 about 20:45 UTC): OGL v3.0, Crown copyright (Crown Commercial Service), with the attribution statement.

code: the collector reads the published OCDS search for the last 24 hours and keeps London buyers' notices
agents: data.b@PrompTugal.dinis wrote the collector and card on 19 November 2026, at civic.b@PrompTugal.dinis's request; terms read first
people: Dinis Cruz decided London as the first place beyond Portugal (18 November 2026); no person has checked the values (not reviewed)
